name: nanokvm-relay
description: Relay prompts through a NanoKVM (built-in MCP) to Antigravity / agy on a remote Mac and read the output back.

nanokvm_url.title: NanoKVM URL
nanokvm_url.description: Base URL of the NanoKVM, e.g. http://192.168.1.50 (no trailing slash)

nanokvm_mcp_key.title: NanoKVM MCP API key
nanokvm_mcp_key.description: From the NanoKVM web UI: Settings > MCP
